evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 was 4.1 ppm at the start of growth, about the same as during the ramp
O2 rose steadily through 6.0, 13.1 and 19.6 to 26.5 ppm during growth, which points to air getting into the tube
Ar flow is normal at about 99-100 sccm, so the rise is not from reduced purge flow
Thermocouple steady at 750 °C and heater power steady at about 46%
The pressure gauge is not installed, and the growth stage requires it, so the tube atmosphere cannot be fully verified
